A directory with a file in it and nothing a survey can read as behaviour: no
manifest, no entry point, no route, no config key, no test name, no error path,
and no prose about itself either. Both evidence tiers come back under their
floor here, which is the state the survey has to refuse to draft from.

It is copied out of the repository before it is surveyed. Surveyed in place it
would inherit this repository's change history as weak evidence and stop being
barren, which would silently retire the refusal this fixture exists to reach.
